capabilities: Highlights GDB, pwndbg, GEF and PEDA output in code blocks
Recognizes registers, disassembly, stacks, heap chunks and memory maps
Tolerates copy/paste damage like tabs, CRLF and NBSP
Registers Prism grammars for reading view code blocks
Decorates blocks in Live Preview with CodeMirror 6 marks
disambiguation: Not a debugger or debugger integration; it only adds syntax highlighting to pasted debugger output in code blocks.
extras: Grammars are plain Prism grammars reusable outside Obsidian (blogs, Docusaurus); colours follow the theme via --dbg-* CSS variables.
problem: Obsidian renders pasted debugger output as plain monochrome code, losing the colours and structure the debugger tools provide.
summary: Syntax highlighter that colours pasted GDB, pwndbg, GEF and PEDA debugger output in Obsidian code blocks.
